claims.claim: MasTec reported record Q2 2026 revenue of $4.374B (+23.4% YoY) and record 18-month backlog of $21.391B (+30%), with Clean Energy and Infrastructure revenue up 43.4% and Power Delivery up 19.2%.
MasTec closed its acquisition of The Superior Group, adding a roughly 3,000-person electrical contractor with recognized data-center infrastructure capability.

factors.name: power/data-center infrastructure exposure
factors.basis: Backlog growth, power-delivery growth and Superior's data-center electrical capability position MasTec against grid and compute-infrastructure buildout.

risks.risk: Acquisition integration and project execution can erode expected margin/quality benefits from backlog growth.

unknowns.unknown: Exact data-center contribution within consolidated backlog is not quantified in the release.

claims.claim: Q2 adjusted EBITDA rose 39.8% YoY to $384M and adjusted EBITDA margin expanded 100 bps to 8.8%; MasTec raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $9.30 and adjusted EBITDA guidance to $1.6B.

factors.name: execution and guidance conversion
factors.basis: Broad revenue growth, margin expansion, record backlog and raised full-year guidance provide multiple execution checkpoints.

risks.risk: Q2 free cash flow was negative $59M despite strong earnings, so cash conversion remains an execution check.

contradictions.claim: Record earnings/backlog alongside negative quarterly free cash flow
contradictions.resolution: Both remain valid; strong operating momentum does not eliminate working-capital and cash-conversion risk.
